description: Recipe for the creator's two-Spark MiniMax H3 Ref2VA stack (knapcio/MiniMax-H3-2x-DGX-Spark-TP2 at 2845006): vLLM-Omni v0.30.0 continuing 277-frame windows from each other for 16 to 60 second clips with synchronized audio, conditioned on one to nine reference images (look and subject, not a first frame). 960x576 and 20 steps by default, reference short edge 1024 as the creator recommends for long clips.

duration.description: Video length, 16 to 60 seconds, rendered in continued windows.
duration.label: Duration

flow-shift.description: Noise schedule shift; the creator's default is 12. Any positive number is accepted.
flow-shift.label: Flow shift

num-inference-steps.description: More steps refine the video and take longer. The creator's example uses 20.
num-inference-steps.label: Denoising steps

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed and options give the same video.
seed.label: Seed

title: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA long clips two-Spark vLLM-Omni (knapcio)
